prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create exactly ONE fully designed, high-fidelity website homepage screenshot for Birdcar, 1536 x 1024 pixels, landscape desktop viewport, no browser chrome, no device, no surrounding presentation board. This is a polished, category-standard professional-services homepage, composed with exceptional care and restrained confidence. Full visual fidelity, impeccable readable typography and alignment, generous but efficient spacing. Do not make the conventional option boring, underdesigned, caricatured, or deliberately inferior.

REFERENCE: The supplied image /tmp/birdcar-alkaline-specimen.png is a LETTERFORM-ONLY reference. It shows the actual Alkaline connected script used for the Birdcar wordmark and the main display headline. Match those letters closely: substantial dark strokes, crisp connected cursive, confident rightward slant, lively controlled terminals. Carry over only the letterform style and exact words, not the specimen's overall composition or black color. Barlow sans-serif for navigation, supporting copy, labels, process titles, and controls.

WEBSITE STRUCTURE IN ORDER:
1. White horizontal navigation, approximately 100 px tall, 112 px left/right page margins and a thin subtle bottom rule. Navy Alkaline wordmark “Birdcar” on the left. Familiar clean navigation on the right: “How it works”, “Selected work”, “Contact”. Calm, professional spacing.
2. Spacious split hero from roughly y=140 to y=600. White ground. Left column approximately 580 px wide: very large navy Alkaline connected-script headline “More room to grow.”, arranged across two attractive lines if needed, unmistakably the typographic focal point. Under it, clear Barlow body text, about 21 px: “Custom systems for established service businesses. Reduce the chasing, copying and work that depends on you remembering every step.” Give the paragraph a comfortable reading measure. Below, one blue solid rectangular action with modest 5 px corner radius, white text “Book a free assessment” and a small right arrow.
Right column: a refined illustrative physical assessment report on a cool light grey #EEF2F6 rectangular presentation ground, with subtle paper shadow and disciplined editorial layout. The illustration is clearly an example of the deliverable, not a live dashboard or fabricated evidence. A single elegant white report sheet, near front facing with only minimal perspective, has a small readable label “Example assessment”, prominent Barlow title “A plan you can keep”, three well-spaced horizontal report rows titled “Client onboarding”, “Reporting”, and “Follow-up”. Pair each row with a small clear blue outline symbol and a few faint typographic-length grey lines suggesting text. A quiet blue rule or top binding accent. No charts, no percentages, no metrics, no notification badges. Keep the report legible and composed.
3. Lower section from roughly y=650 to y=935 with full-width light grey #EEF2F6 ground. At the left page margin, a readable navy heading “Start with a conversation. Leave with a plan.” in restrained Barlow medium, approximately 34 px. Below, an evenly spaced, three-column process with small blue step numerals 01 / 02 / 03, no heavy card borders: “Assessment” with “Understand the work and get a written plan.”; “Scoped implementation” with “Build and test the right improvement together.”; “Ongoing care” with “Keep the system useful as your business changes.” These are sequential step markers, not business metrics.
4. If space permits, a narrow white selected-work text strip along the bottom with a small label “Selected work” and two understated project references: “DataDash — Craft & Communicate” and “Workshops — GHX”. Text only; no customer logos, thumbnails, case-study imagery, or attributed endorsement.

EXACT PALETTE: white #FFFFFF primary ground; cool light grey #EEF2F6 secondary ground; navy #142C3B primary type and wordmark; clear blue #2362CE action and modest accents. Restrained neutral secondary type. Flat website surfaces with a subtle shadow only for the illustrative paper report. No beige, no purple, no decorative gradients, no dramatic textures.

CONTENT AND EVIDENCE: Established service businesses are the audience. The main visitor action is booking the free assessment. The written report is theirs to keep. Use only the exact supplied text; process copy may wrap naturally. No fabricated customer quotes, statistics, prices, availability statements, guaranteed outcomes, customer logos, or invented people. No owner portrait or invented photograph presented as client work. The report is explicitly labeled “Example assessment”. No extra sections, decorative slogan, unreadable microcopy, or floating decorative widgets. Every region should read as a real, implementable website interface.
reference_role: Letterforms only; actual Alkaline wordmark and headline specimen
